messages:
Maya Chen: ok team — drafting a compact 'earlybird' sequence for the product launch newsletter. goal: accelerate signups + webinar RSVPs without spamming. thoughts on cadence?
Samir Patel: love the name 🎯. i'd keep it 3 emails over 7 days: intro, social proof/benchmarks, webinar invite/reminder. short subjects.
Priya Rao: agree on 3 sends. suggest segmenting by recent activity: active-trial, dormant-trial, inbound-leads. tailor copy: product-centric vs ROI-centric.
Carlos Mendez: can we stagger send windows by timezone & engagement tier? e.g., morning local time for high-engage, evening for low-engage. reduces open competition.
Maya Chen: yes. propose send windows config: ```
- High engagement: 9am local
- Medium: 11am local
- Low: 6pm local
```
Samir Patel: subject line roughs (A/B):
- A: "Early access: see how teams cut LLM costs by 3x"
- B: "Join the launch + live cost + latency benchmark"
Priya Rao: add a soft personalization token for product usage: "See {feature} in action" for active-trial.
Carlos Mendez: routing: inbound MQLs -> welcome + invite immediately; trial signups older than 14d -> nurture path with benchmark case study; enterprise leads -> wait for SDR touch then invite.
Maya Chen: ok actionable checklist: 1) finalize subject lines + preheaders 2) build segment filters 3) configure send windows 4) add UTM params 5) schedule webinar timeblocks 6) QA email render + spam tests
Samir Patel: UTM pattern suggestion: `utm_source=newsletter&utm_campaign=earlybird_launch&utm_content={segment}` — we can swap campaign to include date.
Priya Rao: QA: need Litmus screenshots + inbox placement for gmail/outlook/apple. i'll take that.
Carlos Mendez: A/B roll: 40/40/20 split? run for 24-36 hours then pick winner for tails.
Maya Chen: agreed. metrics to watch: open, click-to-rsvp, webinar RSVP->attendee conversion, new signups, cost per signup. set dashboards in GA + internal reporting.
Samir Patel: copy note: avoid deep technical jargon in top-level email. reserve benchmarks in secondary content and landing page.
LaunchBot: campaign queued: earlybird_sequence_v1 scheduled for 2024-06-15 09:00 UTC. status: draft (waiting approve).
Maya Chen: approvals: @Priya @Samir can you review subject + segment list by EOD today? I'll merge and handoff to ops for scheduling.
Priya Rao: on it, will post comments in doc.
Samir Patel: will check creative and report back by 4pm. :+1:
Carlos Mendez: i'll prepare send windows config and timezone mapping csv and drop in the campaign folder.
Maya Chen: perfect — once approved we'll run a small smoke test (2k users) then full ramp. low-risk split: monitor deliverability before pushing full send.
Samir Patel: small smoke test sounds good. any preference for which segment first? active-trial high-engage to validate subject + landing page.
Priya Rao: agreed. let's capture feedback from smoke test in the benchmark doc and iterate subject lines if CTR < 6%.
Maya Chen: great. that's enough to move forward. i'll update the doc with action owners. thanks all :)
